name: meta-stamp-pockets
description: Licensing and receipts for AI agent access to creator content. Every visit goes on the record: a licensed pull returns the content with a receipt, a refused one returns a receipt that says no, and the owner's ledger gets the same entry. Patent pending.
author: Chris Coyne

auth.description: API key required. Get one at https://app.meta-stamp.com/customer-signup

pricing.description: The owner sets the price, per asset.
